title: The Euler classes of taut foliations on graph manifolds
summary: In this paper, we determine the set of Euler classes of all taut foliations for a family of closed graph manifolds. As a consequence, for any closed aspherical graph manifold $Y$, every integral class in the closed dual Thurston unit ball can be virtually realized as the Euler class of some taut foliation. In particular, $Y$ virtually admits a taut foliation with vanishing Euler class. We present examples of graph manifolds with arbitrarily large first Betti number, which admit no taut foliations with vanishing real Euler classes.
